s.note: Thin double-fried fries in paper cones with tomato sauce
s.how: Cut 1kg potatoes into thin fries and soak in cold water for an hour. Dry well, fry at 140C until soft, then fry again at 190C until golden and crisp. Toss with fine salt and pile into paper cones with tomato sauce on the side.

s.note: Gruyère and Swiss melted in white wine, with baguette and apple to dip
s.how: Rub a pot with a cut garlic clove. Warm 250ml white wine, then stir in 200g grated gruyere and 200g grated Swiss cheese tossed with a spoon of cornflour until smooth. Keep warm over low heat and dip in cubes of baguette and apple.

m.note: two smashed patties, American cheese, pickles and tangy sauce
m.how: Roll 800g chuck mince into 8 balls of 100g. Mix 4 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tbsp mustard and 1 tbsp chopped pickles. Heat a heavy pan until smoking, add the balls, smash flat, season and cook 2 minutes. Flip, add cheese and cook 1 minute. Toast 4 buns. Stack two patties per bun with sauce, pickles and finely diced onion, and wrap in baking paper.

w.note: Thin crêpes with lemon and sugar, or banana and melted chocolate
w.how: Whisk 150g flour, 2 eggs and 375ml milk until smooth and rest for an hour. Cook thin crêpes in a buttered pan for a minute a side. Fold with a squeeze of lemon and sugar, or with sliced banana and melted dark chocolate.

d.note: Fresh lemon juice, sugar syrup and iced water, mixed at the table
d.how: Squeeze 6 lemons into a jug. Dissolve 100g sugar in 100ml hot water and cool. Put lemon juice, syrup and a jug of iced water on the table and let everyone mix their own glass to taste.
